verdict.rationale: Eqvista's docs say waterfall modeling lets teams run distribution scenarios across share classes and stakeholder groups, and a community user names waterfall analysis as a feature. The evidence does not show how the model treats liquidation preferences or participation, or that it compares multiple exit values, which are central to this story. Missing for 10: documented handling of liquidation preferences and participation (including caps), explicit multi-exit-value scenario comparison, detailed docs or hands-on corroboration of per-stakeholder proceeds output.
